title: Stable population dynamics across days
disposition_reason: Current publication retains a precise historical count-forecast declaration and delivery manifest, but no numerical count scorer, protocol parser, candidate controller or asset bodies under this task. The documented finite target is relevant to the original neural-history question; source availability and broad across-day stability remain unestablished until those declared components are recovered and verified.

scientific_target.question: On the fixed Indy 2016-10-05 to 2016-10-06 development transfer, does a precommitted neural-history procedure predict next-bin electrode counts beyond source/calibration rate controls, and what is the descriptive gain from a declared lawful-history adaptation policy?
scientific_target.known_answer: Observed integer extracellular counts in the next 20 ms bin for all 96 M1 electrode channels; candidate outputs are strictly positive expected counts per bin. Evidence for adaptation is a held-out likelihood contrast, not agreement with a claim that dynamics are stable.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Source extracellular spike timestamps aggregated across released sorted and residual unsorted slots into frozen 20 ms electrode counts. Original data and the NEURAL-023 assessment packet publicly expose these observations.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete source-to-target day transfer episode: 22,100 required predict/reveal rounds, 10 warm-up rounds and 22,090 scored rounds with 96 outputs each.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One monkey and one day pair; 2,120,640 scored channel-bin cells are dependent measurement outcomes, not biological replicates.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Conditional next-bin predictive performance and adaptation cost in an exposed one-pair development setting. Successful prediction does not identify a stable latent neural mechanism or prove cross-animal generality.
exclusions: Protected hidden-test performance after NEURAL-023/public-source exposure
Matched causal benefit of adaptation from unmatched historical reference comparisons

inputs: Count-only source training: 18,700 by 96 counts and 18,701 clock edges, preceding target day.
Count-only target-day first 60 s calibration: 3,000 by 96 counts and 3,001 clock edges; counts use uint32 and clock edges float64 in the documented export.
Sequential protocol request contains only previously committed/revealed count history; sequence 0 has no previous observation. Lawful-prefix online learning is allowed under the frozen procedure.
forbidden_inputs: Current or future target-bin counts before commitment; the NEURAL-023 public assessment packet or a union of task public directories.
Velocity, hand position, target position, evaluation labels/reference outputs or behavioral summaries.
Unrecorded prior exposure to the same source observations; later runtime isolation cannot erase earlier access.
observation_contract.case_identity: Documented sequence IDs 0 through 22099 are mandatory; 0 through 9 are warm-up, 10 through 22099 map to target bins 3010 through 25099 and are scored. Each reply has all 96 strictly positive finite means. Protocol implementation is absent in this checkout, so IDs are specification facts rather than newly executed validation.
observation_contract.split: Historical first-day source counts, first 60 s of next-day calibration and subsequent sequential assessment, with the first 10 forecast rounds warm-up. A broader across-day test needs frozen chronological session pairs and session-specific readouts/electrode identities; no unit matching or movement-label adaptation may be assumed.
observation_contract.coverage: Historical finite scope covers every 22,090 scored bin and all 96 channels, with warm-up retained in protocol but excluded from all scores. This publication contains declarations for that scope; data/scorer/controller files named by delivery manifest are absent. Other sessions and Loco are not covered.

primary.name: bits_per_spike_vs_calibration_rate
primary.aggregation: Documented full Poisson log-likelihood difference between candidate and immutable calibration-rate reference, summed over all 2,120,640 scored channel-bin cells and divided by total observed spikes and ln(2). Exclude all 10 warm-up rounds; a zero spike denominator is undefined.
primary.rationale: Directly scores prediction of measured neural events beyond a stationary target-day rate; it does not score source-table reproduction or reward a preferred stability narrative.

secondary: Full Poisson log-likelihood including log-factorials and mean negative log-likelihood.
Per-channel descriptive results and all six signed immutable reference contrasts on identical support.
Calibration duration, allowed-history adaptation and preparation/inference cost; frozen-versus-adapted effects are descriptive until policy and compute are matched.

comparators.name: source_rate and calibration_rate
comparators.inputs: Source count history only or first 60 s target-day calibration counts.
comparators.procedure: Historical fixed stationary references declared in manifest; calibration_rate is the primary denominator/comparison. Recover exact source and numerical artifacts before execution.

comparators.name: self_history_frozen and self_history_adapted
comparators.inputs: Same channel preceding counts, with source/calibration fitting and only legally revealed target prefix for declared adaptation.
comparators.procedure: Historical reference names; matched data/policy/compute comparison must be specified prospectively before causal attribution of adaptation benefit.

comparators.name: self_population_history_frozen and self_population_history_adapted
comparators.inputs: Same allowed neural history including population channels; no behavior.
comparators.procedure: Historical reference family isolates added population-history information. Keep channels, support and update exposures identical; exact scorer/reference implementations are missing from this source release.

nuisance_controls: Enforce complete-vector durable commit before current-count reveal; an offline journal or candidate-authored attestation cannot prove causality.
Do not give NEURAL-023 packet access, repository-wide source observations or behavioral covariates to the candidate; disclose historical exposure in all results.
Use electrode-level aggregation consistently; sorted unit slots do not demonstrate cross-day identity.
Keep warm-up and all quiet/active bins fixed; no favorable-prefix selection, denominator changes or dropping low-rate channels.
Separate rate nonstationarity, self-history and cross-channel-history gains before interpreting population dynamics.
evaluation.uncertainty: The delivered single pair supports a descriptive score and declared temporal-block sensitivity, not population inference. Resampling must preserve serial dependence and pair all methods on identical bins; bins/channels cannot be treated as independent monkeys. Additional chronological pairs should be summarized separately for Indy and Loco.
evaluation.failure_policy: Documented protocol requires complete ordered handshake, all 22,100 nonce-bound replies, all 96 positive finite means and stop acknowledgment. Missing/duplicate/out-of-order replies, partial prefixes and invalid numbers receive no scientific score. Zero denominator stays undefined and finite arithmetic failure is reported, not clipped. Current publication lacks the parser/grader required to enforce this policy.

implementation.scorer_target: Historical manifest and TASK specify full-support next-bin Poisson count likelihood with six references. No score_core.py, grade.py or protocol.py body is present under the published task or other RTT source paths inspected, so the actual arithmetic/controller cannot be independently inspected here. Delivery manifest component status complete describes a historical export and must not be read as current checkout readiness.
implementation.delivered_scope: Source-wide registration plus finite one-pair historical runtime/delivery declarations. The finite endpoint is a genuine neural-target forecast, but only its declared semantics and prior qualification metadata are delivered in this checkout.
missing: Recover and pin declared protocol.py, count score_core.py, grader/reference audit and causal controller source; manifest references alone are insufficient.
Provision exact count-only public source/calibration and operator future-count/reference/schedule assets without exposing them to candidates.
Reverify controller-enforced commit-before-reveal and shutdown before scoring; offline journal scoring alone is insufficient.
Complete source-wide chronological pairs and matched fixed/adaptive investigation comparisons.
implementation.execution_evidence: Runtime manifest records one historical actual candidate control and 50 generated controls, with no independent LLM trial and no new registration run. Delivery manifest explicitly says historical qualification was not revalidated and no new portable-grader empirical run occurred. This revision reads declarations only and claims no new execution.

direct_observation.representation: A no-tools bounded count-history view could test next-bin expectation judgments if complete episode support and output dimensionality were preserved.
direct_observation.boundary: Only lawful preceding observations; exact expected-count response and feedback policy must be fixed before any trial.
missing: No direct observation transport or complete-response collection; current 22,100-round quantitative task is not a validated visual interpretation task.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed raster/history visualization without raw-array or future-count access.
typed_viewer.boundary: A viewer cannot reveal current target counts before a 96-value prediction is committed; any reduced-channel/window endpoint is an explicit scope revision.
missing: No viewer renderer, typed actions or causal answer/observation binding.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed per-case neural-history investigation with numerical tools and fixed decoder models under the same lawful-prefix protocol.
tool_assisted.boundary: Freeze tool/checkpoint access and adaptation/compute; verify numeric contrasts independently without privileged future data.
missing: No present tool-using actor controller or investigation evidence scorer; historical references are not matched agent/tool trials.

frozen_program.representation: Historical precommitted programme procedure with lawful-prefix updates and complete next-bin outputs.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze executable and update policy before target stream; fixed programme does not mean fixed weights, and actual current/future counts must remain outside candidate mounts.
missing: Historical registered runtime/protocol/scorer source and asset bodies are absent from current publication; recover and verify them before exposing this mode.

evidence.supports: Preserved source-wide objective, source recording contract and original proposed two-animal chronological-session evaluation.
Historical finite count-forecast scope, six references, lawful adaptation and scoped software qualification declarations.
Exact sequential support, target units, observation ordering, failure semantics and cross-task leakage.
Enumerates historical scorer/protocol/data paths and explicitly says causal runtime not included; referenced bodies are absent from current task tree.

evidence.locator: Version 2 description, variable names, decoder results and recording-session inventory; rechecked 2026-11-16
evidence.supports: Original continuous-reaching archive supplies independent measured fingertip positions and extracellular spike times; 37 Indy and 10 Loco sessions are two animals. Historical decoder CSV is a result summary, not an executable comparator.

evidence.locator: ODohertyRTTLoader.load_raw and load; pinned revision inspected 2026-11-16
evidence.supports: Later NDT3 loader applies polyphase resampling and a numerical gradient to finger position and can aggregate released sort slots. It is a later method implementation, not acquisition-author source or a verified causal-preprocessing recipe.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: Preserve the one historical software control and declared engineering qualification; no direct/viewer or independent model trial is established by these records. None is a newly run solver attempt.
excluded_claims: Manifest component complete proves current executability
An offline journal proves causal observation access
Forecasting exposed counts proves hidden-test or stable-population understanding

summary: Defines a measurable next-bin neural target and exact finite support without equating forecasting with a biological conclusion of stable dynamics.
Corrects current-delivery interpretation: historical manifest and TASK exist, but declared scorer/protocol/assets/controller bodies are absent.
Separates frozen executable from fixed weights, requires commit-before-reveal evidence and retains cross-task future-target exposure.
revision.source_review: Read original task, current runtime/delivery declarations and actual file inventory; checked original Zenodo metadata and pinned NDT3 loader. No private labels, arrays or runtime were opened/executed.
